scope: Static component source review only; no code imported or run, no GPU result, no H200 performance claim. Source downloaded for read-only inspection under /tmp.
findings: SM90 has no native Float4E2M1 conversion: kNativeDequantLowBitFamily requires family >=1000.

Generic fp_to_fp conversion uses masked/shifted sign/exponent bit expansion; this is the same broad representation technique already specialized in our parent, with no new operation-count or phase advantage established.
fused_dequant_single_for_mxfp4 specializes only Float8E4M3 and Int8 targets, not BFloat16. It is not an eligible direct BF16 conversion replacement.

SM90 policy uses separate schedule decisions for WNA16 MoE and short-M dense shapes. Alternative complete pipelines have not been benchmarked against our current parent; do not infer they are slower from generic helper instruction counts.
Published W4A8 and native W4A4 headline gains do not justify lowering the task activation precision.
